title: Viability, Distribution and Penetration of Human Gingival Fibroblasts into Three Types of Acellular Dermal Matrix Membranes
authors: Esmaeilnejad A, Kadkhodazadeh M, Mohammadi S, Yadegari Z, Amid R. J. Oral Maxillofac. Surg. 2021 May; 1-12. doi: 10.1007/s12663-021-01584-3.
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss mucoderm (porcine collagen soft-tissue matrix) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Viability, distribution and penetration of HGFs into SureDerm and Mucoderm were more favorable than into thick Regen” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
